newsitem.title: USA: Town & Country names Schawbel president.
newsitem.headline: Town & Country names Schawbel president.

text.p: Town & Country Corp said on Friday that it named William Schawbel as acting president and co-chairman of the board.
Schawbel was appointed after the board accepted the resignation of C. William Carey, chairman and chief executive officer, Town & Country said.
The company will post a $3.9 million charge for severance payments for Carey, who held the post of chief executive for 41 years.
Charles Hill, a director since 1984, will serve as co-chairman of the Board, sharing duties with Schawbel.
Carey will continue to assist the company on special projects, as requested by the board, and will remain a significant shareholder, Town & Country said.
Schawbel was previously an executive at Gillette Co, Town & Country said.
